# t2.2.1 — Frontend DTO alignment and signed-in flow verification

## Summary

Aligned browser response DTOs and demo MSW responses with the versioned `/v1` schemas, adding explicit API-to-view adapters for the existing screens. Verified the signed-in demo flow from overview through issues to filtered logs using contract-shaped responses. No `docs/PLAN.md` checkbox was changed in this task.

## Deliverables

- [t2.2.1-frontend-batch-report.yaml](./t2.2.1-frontend-batch-report.yaml) — implementation file map, test evidence, upstream traceability, and boundaries.
- [checkpoints/t2.2.1-frontend-tasks-to-impl.yaml](./checkpoints/t2.2.1-frontend-tasks-to-impl.yaml) — task-to-code checkpoint.

## Implementation

- `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`, `apps/web/src/hooks/queries.ts` — typed wire DTOs for overview, issues, logs, settings, providers, rules, and accuracy; adapters normalize API decimals and fields at the query boundary.
- `apps/web/src/mocks/state.ts`, `handlers.ts`, `handlers.test.ts` — demo endpoints now return the versioned response envelopes and fields; settings and delete requests follow the backend request/response behavior.
- `apps/web/src/components/settings/AccuracySection.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/PricingTable.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/Providers.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/Overview.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/IssueDetail.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/Topbar.tsx` — consume fields actually present in the API, including separate accuracy datasets and nullable pricing/confidence.
- `apps/web/src/components/settings/{RulesSection,WindowsSection,UpstreamSection}.tsx` — use backend threshold names, send required real-upstream confirmation, and keep disabled tier-3 text legible.
- `apps/web/src/lib/api.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/mocks/handlers.test.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/app.spec.ts` — adapter, response-shape, and signed-in demo journey coverage.

## Remaining Boundaries

- The browser test uses the local signed-in demo session and contract-shaped MSW responses. It is not proof of a real Supabase session, live JWT-to-browser integration, or provider OAuth. No user-controlled credentials/provider configuration were available, so the real-account I1 criterion remains unchecked.
- `docs/PLAN.md` D5/F3 specifies generated frontend types (`openapi-typescript`, `npm run gen:api`, `src/api/schema.d.ts`). This task aligned handwritten wire DTOs against the schemas but did not implement or verify type generation; keep F3 unchecked and handle it separately.
- The required preflight `context.md` and `decisions.md` were not present; available dependency artifacts and the read-only board supplied the task context.
